what.fr: Les affirmations non étayées des agents ont nettement diminué pour trois des quatre types d'échec une fois les formateurs corrigés.
what.en: Unsupported agent claims dropped substantially for three of the four failure types.

rejected.detail: The quote does not say the drop happened after formatters were corrected, which the French version adds, and the two versions differ in this respect.

what.fr: Selon Florian Brand, le LiteLLM a été compromis de nouveau, la cause préliminaire étant une clé d'API restée commitée sur GitHub pendant cinq mois.
what.en: Florian Brand says LiteLLM was compromised again, with a preliminary report attributing it to an API key committed to GitHub for five months.

rejected.detail: The quote does not name LiteLLM; 'they' is unspecified and the speaker identity is not established by the quote alone.

what.fr: Florian Brand décrit une faille PHP d'exécution de code à distance, trouvée par le programme OpenAI Patch the Planet avec d'autres chercheurs, signalée à la PHP Foundation puis corrigée.
what.en: Florian Brand describes a PHP remote code execution bug that OpenAI's Patch the Planet program and other researchers found and reported to the PHP Foundation, which was then patched.

rejected.detail: The quote does not mention a PHP remote code execution bug nor that it was patched; it only says the bug was found and reported to the PHP Foundation.

what.fr: Florian Brand estime qu'un modèle de 3 000 milliards de paramètres demande des B300, un nœud par réplique du modèle.
what.en: Florian Brand says that fitting the roughly three-trillion-parameter model requires B300s, one node per model replica.

rejected.detail: The quote does not state the model is roughly three trillion parameters, which the claim adds.

what.fr: Kimi K3.1 Pro : poids ouverts annoncés, capacité cyber offensive volontairement bornée
what.en: Kimi K3.1 Pro: open weights announced, offensive cyber capability deliberately capped

rejected.detail: The headline says 'open weights announced' and 'deliberately capped', which is stated more firmly than the hedged claim, and the cited claim is itself not fully reliable.

It claims the results are neither corroborated nor published by a vendor, and calls it a single source, which are not in the cited facts; it also cites the twelve defects claim only partly in the claimIds mapping.
